200.description: The report for the requested window. An empty window is a 200 with empty `rows`/`byTaskType` arrays and null means — not a 404.

from.description: The inclusive window start, echoed back in UTC.

to.description: The exclusive window end, echoed back in UTC.

rows.description: One row per (taskType, hour bucket), ordered by hour bucket then task type. Always present; empty for a window with no data.

hourBucket.description: Start of the UTC hour this row aggregates.

tasksRecorded.description: Every task recorded in this bucket, including ones with no associate (a robot station), no measurable duration, and no active standard. The honest denominator.

tasksScored.description: The subset that could be scored against a standard.

tasksMeasured.description: The subset whose ActualSeconds was positive — the denominator of meanActualSeconds. Wider than tasksScored: a task can be measured (a real duration) without being scored (no standard to compare against), per ADR 0006's distinction.

meanEfficiencyPct.description: Mean EfficiencyPct across the SCORED tasks only. NULL when nothing in this bucket was scorable — never 0 as a stand-in.

meanActualSeconds.description: Mean observed duration across tasks with a positive ActualSeconds. Independent of whether any standard existed, so it is present for buckets where meanEfficiencyPct is null. NULL when nothing in this bucket was measurable.

standardsDefined.description: LaborStandardDefined events effective in this bucket.

standardsRevised.description: LaborStandardRevised events effective in this bucket. Non-zero means efficiency figures on either side of this bucket are measured against DIFFERENT standards and are not directly comparable.

byTaskType.description: The window collapsed onto one entry per TaskType — the shape a bar chart binds to — sorted by task type so bar order is stable across refreshes. A TaskType with no rows in the window is ABSENT rather than present with zeros.

tasksMeasured.description: The measured subset across the window (denominator of meanActualSeconds).

meanEfficiencyPct.description: Recomputed from the summed raw counters across the window, not averaged from the per-bucket means, so a busy hour weighs more than a quiet one. NULL when no task of this type was scored.

totals.description: The entire queried window collapsed to a single headline.

meanEfficiencyPct.description: Volume-weighted across every task type. NULL when the window contains tasks but none of them were scorable — the headline then honestly reads "20 tasks, no score", never "0%".

totals.title: Totals
